fusions.name: Ram the Pommel
fusions.desc: Drives the pommel forward, dealing 13 damage, knocking the target back 3 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Crag-Top Plunge
fusions.desc: A plunging thrust at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Point-Out Stance
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Won't Give Ground
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 40%, your physical damage rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
